content: <thought>Using the most intense ion at m/z 193.110 as the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 193.110 − 1.007 = 192.103 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely (within typical MS error) and is consistent with the observed ~12 % M+1 intensity is C₈H₁₆O₅ (calculated neutral mass = 192.0998 Da, [M+H]⁺ = 193.1071 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C8H16O5.
